brief.t: Kenna meeting is today. Before it starts, get Aidan's Pure Good, Terra Lotus, and Atlas pricing — all three are overdue. Leave the meeting with a named owner, a number, and a delivery date.

The UnShrink It formula is now in hand. It was confirmed as Formulation confidential dot docx from Sander Reynolds at 52Launch, January twenty-second twenty twenty-six. Sam forwarded it to Aidan yesterday. Aidan must now build the full all-in cost — ingredients, packaging, fill labor, overhead, and margin — and send the quote today.

Send the Tavro proposal to Ben Kar today. Ninety percent close, thirty thousand units, the proposal has never gone out since the June thirtieth call. One document can close the biggest deal by volume on the board.

BEEF BUM sent a shipping label at one fifteen this morning via WhatsApp. Chris needs it fulfilled today. Check and action the eleven other unread WhatsApp threads, including ten unread from MEN STUFF Uberto and five from Smooth Crack Rachel.

A six thousand three hundred fourteen dollar eighty-eight cent Shopify ACH landed in Huntington account CK4274 at three thirty-eight this morning. Balance is forty-one thousand two hundred seventy-five dollars. CRM deposits collected updated to fifty-seven thousand four hundred fifty-four ninety-nine.

Laura must respond to Lainey Henican today. Scent is settled on Honeysuckle. But Lainey has pivoted her brand from the magnolia to a lantern with delicate flowers. Laura needs to confirm the new direction and move forward. The R&D cost question for Lainey is also overdue in the CRM.

Pay the Lynn Corporate Park monthly rent statement and sign the Michigan Office Movers deposit paperwork. Sam already selected the fifty thousand dollar actual cash value coverage at four hundred dollars. Lori confirmed. The twenty-seven fifty deposit is still pending.

kb.a: The UnShrink It formula is confirmed in hand. It lives in a January 22, 2026 email from Sander Reynolds at 52Launch, attached as Formulation confidential dot docx. Sam forwarded it to Aidan on July 20. Aidan now must build the complete all-in quote: formula ingredients, packaging, fill labor, overhead, and approved margin before the quote goes out. Do not send a quote from ingredients alone.

The Kenna meeting is today, July twenty-first. Sam accepted the calendar invite on July 20. Aidan's Pure Good and Terra Lotus pricing has been overdue since July eighth, and the Atlas quote is overdue since July fourteenth. Get these before the meeting or the conversation will stall again. Leave with a named owner, price, and delivery date.

Victor Armendarez, eighty-seven percent close, NDA signed. Curl Defining Cream and Edge Gel, six-ounce jar, two thousand units each. PLL reached Victor by phone July twentieth. Victor is contacting his R&D lab to confirm packaging compatibility. No new contact or result as of July 21 morning. Quote still needs Ronald's raw ingredient costs, packaging, fill labor, and overhead. Margin set at seventy-five percent pending Sam's confirmation.

Ben Kar of Tavro, ninety percent close, about thirty thousand units of custom tallow and argan oil skincare. The proposal has never been sent since the June thirtieth call. This is the single largest deal by volume on the board. Sam should block ten minutes and send it today. One document can close this.

A six thousand three hundred fourteen dollar eighty-eight cent ACH deposit from Shopify landed in Huntington account CK4274 at three thirty-eight this morning, July twenty-first. Account balance is now forty-one thousand two hundred seventy-five dollars and thirty-three cents. CRM deposits collected updated to fifty-seven thousand four hundred fifty-four dollars and ninety-nine cents.

Lainey Henican's Tallow Cream scent is settled on Honeysuckle fragrance — Ronald recommended it and Lainey approved on July twentieth. However, Lainey has now pivoted her branding from the magnolia flower to a lantern as the primary emblem, with delicate flowers surrounding it. The most recent exchange on July twentieth confirmed this direction. Laura must acknowledge the brand revision and move forward. The R&D cost question is also overdue in the CRM.

BEEF BUM client Chris sent a shipping label document on WhatsApp at one fifteen AM this morning, July twenty-first. The message says Here is the shipping label to be fulfilled. This requires a fulfillment action today. There are also eleven total unread WhatsApp threads including ten unread from MEN STUFF Uberto and five from Smooth Crack Rachel.

Sam selected fifty thousand dollar actual cash value coverage at four hundred dollars for the Michigan Office Movers move. Lori from Michigan Office Movers confirmed on July twentieth. The two thousand seven hundred fifty dollar deposit paperwork is still pending Sam's signature and submission. The move date remains around the twenty-eighth.

Lynn Corporate Park's monthly tenant statement arrived July twentieth from Catalyst Management. Operating expenses changed effective January first twenty twenty-six; Sam must review the new total and remit payment. No amount was specified in the email body — the amount is in the attached statement.

STRUCK product preservative challenge test came back PASS. Sam forwarded the PET results from Mark to Ronald and Evelyn on July twentieth for their records. No further action needed from Sam on this item.

Elior dry shampoo quote for five hundred and a thousand units is overdue in the CRM since July fourteenth. Still needs Ronald's BOM, product and packaging clarification, and margin at sixty-five or seventy-five percent. Aerosol matters because it triggers H occupancy and mandatory sprinklers at the new facility.

James Bailey's twelve-ounce Menthol Infused Shampoo production is active in the CRM with deposit received status, total project value eight thousand seven hundred forty dollars. A logo-branded bottle for marketing was requested. Sam must assign the sample production and confirm a ship date.

The ConvertFlow lead capture webhook is fixed and live as of July sixteenth. Leads now flow to the agent and route into Sam's Outlook. First real lead is Hariett at HBI Salon, a custom hair loss shampoo, masque and serum, five hundred to a thousand units. About one hundred five contacts in ConvertFlow await Sam's go-ahead to sort real buyers from junk.

ISO 22716 GMP certification project was signed July sixteenth at fourteen thousand seven hundred dollars. Aidan negotiated and closed it. GMP certification path is officially in motion for the new facility.

Coast Southwest proforma invoice PO 2026-0004 remains unpaid as of July twenty-first. No new email movement found. Jessica Gutierrez says raw materials ship on receipt of funds. Sam needs to release payment or provide a hold reason.

Gusto payroll was due July seventeenth for the June twenty-ninth through July twelfth pay period. The deadline was missed and still needs immediate CEO action. No Gusto confirmation found in today's email scan.

Nadia Dupuis at Oreka Skincare sent a PDF of proposed Canadian label changes on July sixteenth and asked for review. Laura replied she is working on the cream jar. Nadia thanked her. Laura must return the cream jar update and review the label changes today.
Raanan Rosenbaum of Raanan Media booked a thirty minute call with Sam for nine thirty AM Eastern on Thursday July twenty-third.

Hawke Media sent an onboarding survey email on July twentieth asking about Sam's onboarding team experience. Desiree Moore has checked in twice for Ephix kickoff status. Provide a one-line status update so a reply can go out before the account cools further.

New Shopify lead from July twentieth: Oussama Salmi, afghani oil haircare brand selling in Saudi Arabia and Europe, launching in the US. Wants to match formula, five hundred to a thousand units, packaging help, starting now. Email osalmi890@gmail.com, phone plus one seven zero seven seven three one six three seven nine.

Anfal Mohammed sent repeated Shopify Inbox messages July nineteenth seeking per-unit serum or cream pricing above and below one hundred units. Reply with verified pricing only, after confirming exact product, size and quantity.

Jonathan Caesar at Ethnic Gals asked July thirteenth for an inventory spec sheet and pickup count. Aidan should call Jonathan directly and the warehouse should send a written count and pickup status today.
No CRM UPDATE REQUEST or developer reply found after July seventeenth. Do not mark CRM fixes complete or change CRM records based on an assumed fix.

Ads Agent mandate: acquire qualified B2B cosmetics-manufacturing buyers, not consumer shoppers. The business path is Ad to website to email to booked call to close. Seven net-new ads are live for controlled learning. Keep them live and optimize only inside the approved net-new work. Never edit, pause, delete, copy over, or otherwise disturb Sam's legacy campaigns or existing legacy ads. Never claim clicks or impressions as revenue.

Approved paid budget: Contract Manufacturing twenty dollars per day and White Label Samples ten dollars per day, total hard cap thirty dollars per day or two hundred ten dollars per week. Do not raise or move budget beyond this allocation without Sam's explicit approval. July twentieth had a one dollar seventy-two cent overage — investigate before next optimization.

Ads guardrails: net-new work only; legacy campaigns remain untouched. Keep the seven approved net-new ads live for controlled testing. Use B2B manufacturer intent; exclude consumer retail, jobs, DIY, makeup, color cosmetics, and dropshipping. Every landing URL must be click-tested, mobile-clean, matched to the ad, and have a working form. Images and videos need Sam approval before going live.

Ads 7-day comparison (Jul 14–20 vs Jul 7–13). Scope: 7 approved net-new ads only, 6 in PLL-Search-ContractMfg-2026 and 1 in PLL-Search-Samples-2026; legacy ads excluded. Campaigns started Jul 18. Current: thirty-one seventy-two spend, one twenty-two impressions, sixteen clicks, thirteen point eleven percent CTR, one ninety-eight average CPC. Previous: zero. Contract Manufacturing: twenty-five seventy-seven, one fifteen impressions, twelve clicks, ten forty-three CTR, two fifteen CPC. White Label Samples: five ninety-five, seven impressions, four clicks, fifty-seven percent CTR. Inbox: three genuine prospects, zero Google-attributed. Jul 20 exceeded the thirty dollar cap by one dollar seventy-two. Next action: document and investigate cap overage before optimization.

True Revival: client revised to a 200 mL dark-green, light-blocking, shower-safe jar with gold branding. Drake accepts 500 or 1,000 jar MOQ. Laura is sourcing lower-MOQ custom or stock options with domestic decoration.
Open CEO task: rewrite the BrandHaus agreement, review and approve the final terms, then send the approved version to Alex. No confirmed due date or delivery address recorded.
